rev.t:
Whoever marketing guru came up with idea of closing a store in prime market area must have been some different kind of genius.
This store anyway never had adequate stock, with online delivery, it forced us …

This Thippasandra outlet of Reliance was ok for all our needs groceries, vegetables other small appliances.
But now it is closed for public and operates as online service centre only. …
Here all vegetables some how less prices than other sorriunding malls, some of related to sambar,rasam powder's may nearly get upto 20 percent discount.
